text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
My people are always fiery and full of spirit.
One reason may be that the food of our purgatorial land is rich in spicy and sour flavors.
To those unaccustomed, it is said to be so hot and pungent it hurts just to approach—
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちの民は如何なる時も
気炎万丈。
其の一因は
煉獄の地の糧食に、
辛味酸味が多く含まれる故かと存じます。
慣れぬ者には近寄るだけで熱い、
辛いを通り越して痛いと評判なれど──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Yet I have heard from my younger sister that in other worlds,
there exist those with a peculiar disposition called “M,”
who do not shy away from stimulation but actively seek it.
I would very much like to know what such people are like.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし異界には、
刺激を拒まぬばかりか
好んで御身を晒さんとす
「どえむ」なる怪癖を抱きし者が居ると、
妹子より聞き及び候。
その姿が如何なるものか、
わっちもぜひ
識りとう存じまする。
